verdict.rationale: LightSprint's cloud agents appear to run autonomously in isolated sandboxes: they build changes, spin up previews, and work through backlogs in the background without step-by-step confirmation. Human approval happens at the PR/review stage instead. However, no evidence shows a developer-configurable setting to switch between per-action confirmation and auto-approve. Missing for 10: an explicit auto-approve/permission-mode configuration, documentation of per-action confirmation behavior, and hands-on corroboration.
